title: Normalized raw rational compact-support and completed-pullback coefficient families
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and use its finite coefficient stages [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. At stage $E$ use the completed bounded constructible integral category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], its raw rationalization and localization $Q_{W,E}$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], and the scalar functors, associators and shift maps [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. A coherent exact family means the stage functors and exact natural scalar isomorphisms, with their unit, associator and shift equations, as in [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors].
For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square], define $\delta^c_{L/E,K}:H_{c,L}C_{L/E,X}K\to C_{L/E,Y}H_{c,E}K$, where $H_{c,E}=Rp_{*,E}j_{!,E}$ is the ambient operation [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. It is $Rp_{*,L}$ of the inverse open adjunction mate of ordinary scalar/pullback balancing, followed by the inverse proper direct-image scalar comparison [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The open mate is the derived coefficient-change form of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor].
A normalized compact-support coefficient family for $c$ consists of: preservation of the integral category by this composite; a coherent exact family $H$; the equations $H_E\circ Q_{X,E}=Q_{Y,E}\circ H^{int}_{c,E}$ on objects and arrows; shift comparisons equal on integral objects to the localization of the actual ambient shift comparisons [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]; inverse scalar components equal, after the specified integral/scalar identifications, to $Q_{Y,L}(\delta^c_{L/E,K})$ for every integral $K$; and identity scalar isomorphisms at repeated fields.
For a map $u:Y\to X$, a normalized completed-pullback coefficient family consists of: integral preservation of the actual completed pullback $P_{u,E}$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]; a coherent exact family $P$ with $P_E\circ Q_{X,E}=Q_{Y,E}\circ P^{int}_{u,E}$ on objects and arrows; ambient natural comparisons $\delta^u_{L/E}:P_{u,L}C_{L/E,X}\to C_{L/E,Y}P_{u,E}$ characterized by precomposition with the actual ordinary-to-completed unit, giving ordinary scalar/pullback balancing followed by scalar extension of that unit; inverse scalar components equal to their localized components on every integral object; and identity scalar isomorphisms at repeated fields. These are definitions of data, with no assertion that either family exists.
